claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says Taygetan interferometer-family sensors can map local frequency harmonics at molecular level and detect subtle energy, including paranormal activity; spherical drones are a common collection method.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says the sensors can read locations at molecular scale.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu describes spiritual and material realms as occupying the same space, with interaction possible when their frequencies coincide.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says the spiritual realm is lower-frequency on average.
